pages.observedDetails: Lecture 34 title: Fundamentals of Neural Networks.
Objectives include biological history, perceptron, activations, architecture, forward/loss/backpropagation, training, architectures and applications.

Timeline includes perceptron 1958, backpropagation 1986, LeNet1998, AlexNet2012, policy-gradient2016, transformers/RT1 in2020 and LLM/vision2023. Treat historical placements as source claims, not independently established dates.
Touch/camera/IMU/microphone weighted inputs enter sum plus bias, activation and action. Biological correspondences are analogy, not literal equivalence.
Simplified McCulloch-Pitts unit-sum binary threshold model; McCulloch neuroscientist/Pitts logician,1943 attribution. Threshold is manually fixed.
Binary patient-fine toy example uses looks, voice and verbal confirmation; this is not a clinically validated classifier.
Unit-weight threshold2 and three inputs1 give sum3 and output1. No learned weights in this simplified construction.
Source conflates binary-input restriction with affine nonseparability and misattributes perceptron refinement to Minsky/Papert1969. Real-valued support alone does not solve XOR.
Augmented bias x0=1,w0=-theta; inclusive score>=0 outputs1; learned weights and bias.
Move threshold to bias and include constant input. Last bullet overstates bias solely determining shift; distance also depends on weight norm.
MP has fixed threshold/unit sum; perceptron has learned affine parameters; both single binary units.
Separable positive/negative classes, correct predictions unchanged, search for weights including bias.

Both mistake branches in actual pseudocode: add positive x when score<0; subtract negative x when score>=0. Positive update improves its score by squared input norm, not guaranteed immediate correction or componentwise increase.
Hard step is already nonlinear but has zero derivative off its discontinuity. Tanh/sigmoid formulas and graphs; stacked affine identity layers remain affine.
Sigmoid/tanh table uses closed endpoint shorthand; finite-real ranges are open. Softmax normalized classes differs from independent sigmoid multilabel outputs.
Activation-only sigmoid product explains shrinking factors; arbitrary full Jacobian includes weights. Tanh maximum derivative1, not .25.
ReLU,leaky slope.01,GELU=xPhi(x); negative GELU minimum rounded to-.17; no blanket cure for all gradient failure.
Three inputs,four hidden nodes,one output; ReLU(W1x+b1); layer-vector formula is broader than prose first-neuron wording.
Output sigmoid(W2a1+b2); distinguish hidden feature nonlinearity and output representation.
Diagram order forward,loss,backpropagation,descent; backprop computes gradients,optimizer changes parameters.
Affine preactivation plus activation; prediction with fixed parameters. No-learning statement qualified for stateful training layers.
Target-based loss compares prediction and label. Training-only wording overstates; validation/test loss possible if labels exist.
Binary/categorical log objectives printed without minus; categorical loss mislabeled softmax. MSE mean squared residual given.
Chain-rule gradients propagate backward,descent opposite gradient; source groups optimizer into backprop loosely.
Weights/bias parameters,eta hyperparameter; single-example half loss is separate scaling,not n=1 algebra alone.
Linear scalar half-loss gradients ex and e; nonlinear output would add activation derivative.
Simultaneous weight/bias descent equations and iteration. Arbitrary eta does not guarantee decrease; linked interactive resource.
Braking torque target10Nm at2m,initialw3,b1,eta.1. Random wording does not change given literals.
Prediction7,half-loss4.5; ordinary single-example MSE9.
Old-state gradients(-6,-3) both use same prediction7.
Simultaneous neww3.6,b1.3 predicts8.5 and half-loss1.125.
Graph motor-speed label conflicts with torque example. Source notebook hyperlink. Plot shows initial pre-update state; five-frame notebook history not final updated state.
CNN diagram conv,pool,conv,pool,flatten,dense10,output digit7; shown sizes28,12,8,4 require supplied convolution assumptions for inverse kernel calculations.
Recurrent computation receives xt and ht-1; ht carries learned summary,not guaranteed complete memory. Sequential IMU/trajectory/speech uses.
Transformer figure includes positions,masked decoder attention,encoder-decoder middle attention,AddNorm,N repeats,linear-softmax. Regardless-order prose needs positional qualification.
Application and aim clouds overlap EmbodiedAI; surgical robotics versus advanced surgical robots,HRI versus symbiosis; no quantitative performance or dates encoded.
Summary repeats trainable perceptron,MLP activation/training and architecture roles,not new independent mechanism.
